purpose: Falsify one regime-generated hypothesis and two economically distinct mechanisms without modifying any failed Sprint 2 family or frozen beta45 candidate.

hypothesis_provenance.btc_downtrend_intraday_skewness: Generated from the frozen Sprint 2 regime attribution. This is a NEW hypothesis family, not a rescue of discovery_v2_sprint2 intraday_skewness.

data.survivorship_warning: Fixed present liquid universe; historical results do not remove survivorship risk.

execution.first_execution: next available UTC daily open after signal

btc_downtrend_intraday_skewness.hypothesis: When BTC's strictly prior completed 20-day trend is negative, lower realized 4h return skewness predicts higher next-day cross-sectional return than higher skewness.
btc_downtrend_intraday_skewness.btc_gate: log(BTC close_t / BTC close_t-20) < 0 using the last completed daily close before execution
btc_downtrend_intraday_skewness.score: sample skewness of strictly prior completed 4h log returns inside the lookback; only active when the BTC gate is true
btc_downtrend_intraday_skewness.direction: when active long lowest two skewness scores and short highest two; otherwise target flat
btc_downtrend_intraday_skewness.principal_control: same gate with exact reversed cross-sectional direction

funding_carry_spread.hypothesis: Cross-sectional perpetual funding dispersion contains harvestable carry: assets with lower prior realized funding should outperform as long legs relative to short legs with higher prior realized funding after price PnL, actual funding and costs.
funding_carry_spread.score: mean actual funding rate over settlement timestamps strictly before the execution open and within the trailing N calendar days
funding_carry_spread.direction: long lowest two funding scores; short highest two

volume_confirmed_momentum.hypothesis: Recent cross-sectional return continuation is stronger when the completed signal day's contract volume is elevated relative to its own strictly prior baseline.
volume_confirmed_momentum.score: completed one-day close-to-close return multiplied by current completed-day contract volume divided by the median contract volume of the strictly prior N completed days
volume_confirmed_momentum.direction: long highest two scores; short lowest two

family_falsification_gate.selection_if_family_passes: among variants belonging to an adjacent 1.5x-cost-positive neighborhood, select the upper median parameter; never select by maximum PnL

evidence_boundary.positive_sprint_result_only_allows: new frozen candidate followed by independent-engine replication and D2/D3/D4 evidence
